name: DDPM
plain: The classic DDPM posterior step written in VP coordinates: scale the latent into VP space, compute the mean from ε, add posterior noise, scale back. One model call per step.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
ᾱ=1/(σ²+1), ᾱ'=1/(σ'²+1), a=ᾱ/ᾱ'. ε=(x−D)/σ; x_vp=x/√(1+σ²).
μ=(1/√a)(x_vp−(1−a)ε/√(1−ᾱ)). If σ'>0: μ+=√((1−a)(1−ᾱ')/(1−ᾱ))·n. x'=μ·√(1+σ'²).

props.final_sigma0: σ' =0 skips noise and the final rescale; algebra gives μ=D.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch: VP scaling √(1+σ²) is used on flow models too.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: No dedicated node; generic_step_sampler (sampling.py:1062) is used only by this sampler in core.
